sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities on the campus of D'Youville University.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a monitor for the Buffalo city school district
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a monitor for the Buffalo city school district; establishes the powers and duties of such monitor and certain other officers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation for the purposes of constructing a mixed-use campus for the community benefit.

sponsored.t: Relates to judicial districts
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, three new districts, fourteen, fifteen and sixteen are added; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or leak prone
sponsored.sum: Requires gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or leak prone and increase safety reporting relating to gas pipeline leaks; requires the public service commission to establish timelines for the repair, rehabilitation or replacement of leaking or leak prone infrastructure; requires the commission to provide a gas safety report to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Buffalo to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Buffalo to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands for the construction, operation, maintenance, and repair of a utility thermal energy network project.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to establish best practice protocols to screen children four years of age and younger for vision problems
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to establish best practice protocols to screen children four years of age and younger for vision problems.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Hamburg to extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include the village of Blasdell
sponsored.sum: Provides that once the board of trustees of the village of Blasdell abolishes its fire department, the town of Hamburg may extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include such village.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the exclusion of coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint; provides that no insurer licensed or permitted by the superintendent to provide liability coverage to rental property owners shall exclude coverage for losses or damages caused by exposure to lead-based paint.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of lead-based paint test reports in real estate transactions
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of lead-based paint test reports in real estate transactions.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state department of financial services to conduct a study on the rising costs of motor vehicle insurance in the state
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state department of financial services to conduct a study on the rising costs of motor vehicle insurance in the state which shall include certain analyses and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Relates to judicial districts
sponsored.sum: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, two new districts, fourteen and fifteen are added; makes related provisions.

veto.text: POCKET VETO MESSAGE - No. 165 A. 8883 - POCKET VETO - no veto message issued ____________

sponsored.t: Authorizes Melissa Baker to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Melissa Baker to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan for service with the village of Blasdell Police Department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of blood lead levels
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of elevated blood lead levels; provides that elevated lead levels means a blood lead level greater than or equal to 3.5 micrograms of lead per deciliter of whole blood or such lower blood lead level as may be established by the department of health pursuant to rule or regulation.

sponsored.t: Creates a distinctive license plate for veterans honoring Borinqueneers
sponsored.sum: Creates a distinctive license plate for veterans honoring Borinqueneers; defines "veteran" as a person who is a resident of this state, who served in the armed forces of the United States, and was honorably discharged from the armed forces, or has a qualifying condition, as defined in section one of the veterans' services law, and has received a discharge other than bad conduct or dishonorable from such service, or is a discharged LGBT veteran, as defined in section one of the veterans' services law, and has received a discharge other than bad conduct or dishonorable from such service.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for the sale and installation of residential and commercial geothermal heat pump systems equipment
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the sale and installation of residential and commercial geothermal heat pump systems equipment.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain books, magazines, pamphlets and other related items sold at certain book fairs from sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts books, magazines, pamphlets and other related items sold at a primary or secondary school facility or at a library at a book fair organized, hosted or sponsored by an organization established for educational purposes, including but not limited to a parent-teacher association, booster club, or a similar school-based association which supports school activities, or a friends of the library organization from sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on the incidences of cancer clusters in cities and towns having a population of more than ninety thousand
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state department of health to conduct a study on the incidences of cancer clusters in cities and towns having a population of more than ninety thousand.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial assistance from an industrial development agency; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions related to requiring projects be located in a highly distressed area in order to qualify for certain financial assistance from an industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Enables safe access to public roads for all users by utilizing complete street design principles
sponsored.sum: Enables safe access to public roads for all users by utilizing complete street design principles.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the election of qualified transportation fringe benefits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the election of qualified transportation fringe benefits; authorizes any employer to offer employees the opportunity to use pre-tax earnings for the purchase of qualified transportation fringe benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to minimum standards for first aid and enrollment in child day care centers
sponsored.sum: Relates to minimum standards for first aid and enrollment in child day care centers; requires a child day care center's first aid kit include antiseptic or antibacterial ointment; requires a day care center to provide medication consent forms and a copy of its health care plan upon a child's enrollment.

sponsored.t: Requires publishers of books created with the use of generative artificial intelligence to contain a disclosure of such use
sponsored.sum: Requires publishers of books created wholly or partially with the use of generative artificial intelligence to disclose such use of generative artificial intelligence before the completion of such sale; applies to all printed and digital books consisting of text, pictures, audio, puzzles, games or any combination thereof.

sponsored.t: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Erie and a supreme court library at Erie
sponsored.sum: Creates the fourteenth judicial district consisting of the county of Erie and a supreme court library at Erie.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of geothermal energy systems tax credits
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of geothermal energy systems tax credits.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"; provides the city of Buffalo specific procedures for the appointment of a receiver of rents in instances where the property at issue is neglected or abandoned.

sponsored.t: Restricts the formation of new development agencies in Erie county
sponsored.sum: Restricts the formation of new development agencies in Erie County; limits the authority of town industrial development agencies located within Erie County to exempt certain taxes.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for certain fiber optic cable assessments in Erie county.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits for certain sites
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located within the Renaissance Commerce Park situate within the city of Lackawanna, Erie county.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain contract requirements involving glazing work
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain contract requirements involving glazing work; provides that certain contracts over one million and five million dollars that include glazing work to be performed outside of a city with a population of one million or more shall require such work be performed by North American Contractor Certification ("NACC") certified companies; defines glazing work.

sponsored.t: Limits the number of cases a foster care worker may have under his or her supervision at any one time to 16 cases
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of cases a foster care worker may have under their supervision at any one time to 16 cases.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting on merit determinations relating to unfair labor practices and a certificate of compliance to be eligible for state economic incentives
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting on merit determinations relating to unfair labor practices to the department of labor and a certificate of compliance to be eligible for state economic incentives.

sponsored.t: Designates the Scajaquada heritage area
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Designates the Scajaquada heritage area as a state designated heritage area.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain medical professionals certified by a foreign government or another state or territory to provide medical services during the FIFA Club World Cup 2025 and the FIFA World Cup 26
sponsored.sum: Authorizes any person who is licensed or certified as a physician, physician's assistant, massage therapist, physical therapist, chiropractor, dentist, optometrist, nurse, nurse practitioner, emergency medical technician, podiatrist or athletic trainer by a foreign government or another state or territory to provide medical services during the FIFA Club World Cup 2025 and the FIFA World Cup 26.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Hamburg Central School District to utilize certain payments related to video lottery gaming facilities to provide increased support to public schools
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Hamburg Central School District to utilize certain payments related to video lottery gaming facilities to provide increased support to public schools; authorizes such school district in which a video lottery gaming facility is located to receive payments to increase support for public schools.
